decisions.reason: Premium support sits at the core of the firm's announced promise of agency-focused, round-the-clock expert help, so management stays committed to it as a natural extension of its established service.

The version manager was developed in-house, has its own page and is publicly highlighted as a current innovation alongside the security center, so sunk development effort and its fit with the toolset strategy favor keeping it.

Although the contract tool is distant from the core business, the firm built it, presented it publicly and can attribute modest use to the temporary GDPR cycle, so it is likely kept as a low-cost compliance service for customers.
Scalable agency hosting was featured on the home page and embodies the firm's strategic direction toward agencies, making it highly central and visibly committed.
